wayIn.name: the threshold
wayIn.what: Start here: answer one sideways question for a first piece, or skip and open any world card below.

wayIn.name: the mood atlas
wayIn.gloss: how it asks, and every answer
wayIn.what: Try each question style, see what each reading points to, and jump straight into that world.

wayIn.name: site map
wayIn.what: Scan every page in one pass, with one plain line on what to do first on each.

worlds.name: the quiet room
worlds.what: Set a breathing pace, tune the light, and finish by setting one thing down before the next piece opens.

worlds.name: the wish constellation
worlds.what: Read your sky through a lens, catch comet memos, or turn the whole field once around to mint a postcard.

worlds.name: the diary
worlds.what: Write a sky entry line by line, seal it in wax, or call each thought back in order and close the logbook.

worlds.name: the echo chamber
worlds.what: Pulse your stars into echoes, hear them one by one, reshuffle the field, and print the echo weather.

worlds.name: the pulse choir
worlds.what: Set the tempo, mute and reshuffle voices, then finish on a score printed from your sky.

worlds.name: the lantern ritual
worlds.what: Choose the lighting order, kindle lanterns from your stars, set the wind, and release them to rise.

worlds.name: the terrarium
worlds.what: Grow your stars under glass: water stems, read a greenhouse forecast, or regrow the whole bed in a new order.

worlds.name: the weather lab
worlds.what: Map your sky as pressure and fronts, launch probes, and finish with a forecast printed over the live field.

worlds.name: the orbital weaver
worlds.what: Tune symmetry and spin, ripple the weave by touch, and close on a geometry mantra from your stars.

worlds.name: the machine shop
worlds.what: Pick a starting tape, tune one automaton rule, run it, and read what changed at the bit level.

worlds.name: the kinetic floor
worlds.what: Shove blocks, flip gravity, choose what they are made of, and finish with the floor's damage report.

worlds.name: loam
worlds.what: Set soil grit, plant and water, turn the bed, and finish on a core reading from what grew below.

worlds.name: the word kiln
worlds.what: Feed words into heat, pull out coined terms with meanings, and let the batch cool on the shelf.

worlds.name: the apocrypha desk
worlds.what: Accession impossible specimens, cross-reference the drawer, and file one doubtful truth.

worlds.name: the archive oracle
worlds.what: Turn your sky under a wheel, draw an omen, forge a sigil, and stamp the reading into the archive.

finePrint.name: privacy
finePrint.what: Read exactly what stays in your browser, what cookies can count, and how to clear everything.

finePrint.name: terms
finePrint.what: Read the plain bargain: play freely, keep what you make, and expect no warranty.

edges.name: lost in space
edges.what: Miss a page and you still land in the river: the next piece opens here, with every world below.

edges.name: sitemap.xml
edges.what: Get the same page list in XML, with relative paths that work under any publish path.
